        ) and payload.reason is None and payload.start_at is None and payload.end_at is None:

                RoomModel.id == payload.room_id,
                RoomModel.is_deleted == False,
            ).first()
            if not new_room:
                raise AppException(404, f"Room {payload.room_id} not found", "Not Found")
            if not new_room.active:
                raise AppException(409, "Target room is inactive", "Conflict")
            # Check for conflicts in new room
            if cls.check_conflict(db, payload.room_id, app.start_at.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc), app.end_at.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)):
                raise AppException(409, "Target room has scheduling conflict", "Conflict")
            app.room_id = payload.room_id

        if payload.reason is not None:
            app.reason = payload.reason.strip()

        if payload.start_at is not None and payload.end_at is not None:
            s_dt = parse_utc_timestamp(payload.start_at)
            e_dt = parse_utc_timestamp(payload.end_at)
            if s_dt >= e_dt:
                raise AppException(422, "start_at must be strictly earlier than end_at", "Unprocessable Entity")
            if (e_dt - s_dt).total_seconds() / 60 < 15 or (e_dt - s_dt).total_seconds() / 60 > 240:
                raise AppException(422, "Duration must be between 15 and 240 minutes", "Unprocessable Entity")
            # Check for conflicts in original room
            if cls.check_conflict(db, app.room_id, s_dt, e_dt):
                raise AppException(409, "Original room has scheduling conflict", "Conflict")
            app.start_at = s_dt
            app.end_at = e_dt
        elif payload.start_at is not None:
            s_dt = parse_utc_timestamp(payload.start_at)
            if s_dt >= app.end_at.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc):
                raise AppException(422, "start_at must be strictly earlier than current end_at", "Unprocessable Entity")
            # Check for conflicts in original room
            if cls.check_conflict(db, app.room_id, s_dt, app.end_at.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)):

            app.start_at = s_dt

            app.end_at = e_dt

        try:

            db.refresh(app)
            return app
        except Exception:
            db.rollback()
            raise AppException(500, "Database error updating appointment", "Internal Server Error")

        room = db.scalar(
            select(RoomModel).where(RoomModel.id == room_id, RoomModel.is_deleted == False)
        )
        if not room:
            raise AppException(404, f"Room {room_id} not found", "Not Found")

        fields_set = payload.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)
        if not fields_set:
            raise AppException(400, "At least one field must be updated", "Bad Request")

        if payload.name is not None and payload.name != room.name:
            dup = db.scalar(
                select(RoomModel).where(
                    RoomModel.name == payload.name,
                    RoomModel.id != room_id,
                    RoomModel.is_deleted == False,
                )
            )
            if dup:
                raise AppException(409, f"Room name '{payload.name}' already exists", "Conflict")
            room.name = payload.name

        if payload.room_type is not None:
            room.room_type = payload.room_type.value

        if payload.capacity is not None:
            room.capacity = payload.capacity

        if payload.active is not None:
            if payload.active is False and room.active is True:
                # REQ-3-008: A room may be deactivated only if it has no SCHEDULED or CHECKED_IN appointment
                active_appt = db.scalar(
                    select(AppointmentModel)
                    .where(
                        AppointmentModel.room_id == room_id,
                        AppointmentModel.status.in_(
                            [
                                AppointmentStatusEnum.SCHEDULED.value,
                                AppointmentStatusEnum.CHECKED_IN.value,
                            ]
                        ),
                    )
                    .limit(1)
                )
                if active_appt:
                    raise AppException(
                        409,
                        "Cannot deactivate room while SCHEDULED or CHECKED_IN appointments exist",
                        "Conflict",
                    )
            room.active = payload.active

        db.commit()

    def create_appointment(
        db: Session,
        current_user: UserModel,
        payload: AppointmentCreateRequest,
    ) -> AppointmentModel:
        caller_is_admin = current_user.role == RoleEnum.ADMIN.value

        # Validate room

        if not room:
            raise StarletteHTTPException(
                status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
                detail=f"Room {payload.room_id} not found",
            )
        if not room.active:
            raise StarletteHTTPException(
                status_code=status.HTTP_409_CONFLICT,
                detail=f"Room {payload.room_id} is inactive",
            )

        # Validate animal
        animal = db.scalar(
            select(PatientAnimalModel).where(
                PatientAnimalModel.id == payload.animal_id,
                PatientAnimalModel.client_account_id == current_user.id if caller_is_admin else None,
            )
        )
        if not animal:
            raise StarletteHTTPException(
                status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
                detail=f"Animal {payload.animal_id} not found",
            )
        if not animal.active:
            raise StarletteHTTPException(
                status_code=status.HTTP_409_CONFLICT,
                detail=f"Animal {payload.animal_id} is inactive",
            )

        # Validate time window
        s_utc = normalize_utc(payload.start_at)
        e_utc = normalize_utc(payload.end_at)
        if e_utc <= s_utc:
            raise StarletteHTTPException(
                status_code=status.HTTP_422_UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,
                detail="end_at must be strictly later than start_at",
            )
        if (e_utc - s_utc).total_seconds() / 60 < 15 or (e_utc - s_utc).total_seconds() / 60 > 240:
            raise StarletteHTTPException(
                status_code=status.HTTP_422_UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,
                detail="appointment duration must be between 15 and 240 minutes",
            )

        # Check for conflicts
        conflict = db.scalar(
            select(AppointmentModel)
            .where(
                AppointmentModel.room_id == payload.room_id,
                AppointmentModel.status.in_([AppointmentStatusEnum.SCHEDULED.value, AppointmentStatusEnum.CHECKED_IN.value]),
                AppointmentModel.start_at < e_utc,
                AppointmentModel.end_at > s_utc,
            )
        )
        if conflict:
            raise StarletteHTTPException(
                status_code=status.HTTP_409_CONFLICT,
                detail=f"Conflict detected: existing appointment {conflict.id} overlaps with requested slot",
            )

        # Create appointment
        app = AppointmentModel(
            animal_id=payload.animal_id,
            room_id=payload.room_id,
            reason=payload.reason.strip(),
            start_at=s_utc,
            end_at=e_utc,
            status=AppointmentStatusEnum.SCHEDULED.value,
        )
        db.add(app)
        db.commit()
        db.refresh(app)
        return app
